# TrisRendered <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
TrisRendered:Int32
```

**Returns:** The number of triangles that the last [RenderWorld](RenderWorld) drew. It is 0 before the first RenderWorld, and one cube is 12.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* A sprite drawn as an octagon (see [GPU optimizations](GPU-Optimizations#sprite-shapes)) counts as the 6 triangles that are drawn, not as 2, so scenes with many sprites count more than in the original.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 0, 0, 5
RenderWorld
Text 8, 8, "Triangles: " + TrisRendered()
Flip
WaitKey
```
